shellCommands.command: cat package.json && ls -la && ls src 2>/dev/null && cat AGENTS.md | head -50 && ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts && ls __agent_eval__ && grep -n -i -B2 -A6 "dashboard\|dashkit\|grid" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120
npm view @gravity-ui/dashkit version peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | head -40

npm install @gravity-ui/dashkit@10.5.2 @gravity-ui/icons 2>&1 | tail -5 && node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/package.json').version + ' icons ' + require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json').version" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build 2>/dev/null; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit -maxdepth 3 -name "INDEX.md" -o -maxdepth 3 -name "README.md" | head
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md && ls -R node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs | head -40

echo "=== README setup ===" && grep -n -i -A8 "required setup\|styles.css\|import.*css" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md | head -40; echo "=== package exports/style ===" && node -p "const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/package.json'); JSON.stringify({main:p.main,module:p.module,types:p.types,exports:p.exports,style:p.style,deps:p.dependencies},null,1)"; echo "=== dashkit index.d.ts ===" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/index.d.ts; echo "=== typings ===" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/

d=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; echo "=== DashKit.d.ts ===" && cat $d/components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts; echo "=== plugin.d.ts ===" && cat $d/typings/plugin.d.ts; echo "=== config.d.ts ===" && cat $d/typings/config.d.ts; echo "=== ActionPanel ===" && cat $d/components/ActionPanel/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null || ls $d/components/ActionPanel; echo "=== DnDWrapper ===" && cat $d/components/DashKitDnDWrapper/DashKitDnDWrapper.d.ts; echo "=== plugins index ===" && cat $d/plugins/index.d.ts; echo "=== css files ===" && find $d -name "*.css" | head; grep -rn "import.*\.css" $d/index.js $d/components/index.js | head

d=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; echo "=== css imports in js ===" && grep -rn "\.css'" $d/components/DashKitView/DashKitView.js $d/components/GridItem/GridItem.js $d/components/ActionPanel/ActionPanel.js | head; grep -rn "react-grid-layout.*css\|react-resizable.*css" $d --include=*.js | head -3; echo "=== shared types ===" && cat $d/shared/types/config.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120; ls $d/shared/types/; echo "=== common.d.ts (Settings) ===" && grep -n -A30 "export interface Settings\b\|export type Settings\b\|export interface SettingsProps\|export type MenuItem\|export interface MenuItem" $d/typings/common.d.ts | head -90; echo "=== OverlayControlItem ===" && grep -n -B2 -A14 "export interface OverlayControlItem\|export type OverlayControlItem" $d/components/OverlayControls/OverlayControls.d.ts; echo "=== Title plugin ===" && cat $d/plugins/Title/Title.d.ts $d/plugins/Text/Text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo "=== constants ===" && cat $d/plugins/constants.d.ts; echo "=== TRAPS ===" && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

d=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; echo "=== css imports ===" && grep -rhn "import.*css" $d/components/DashKitView/DashKitView.js $d/components/GridItem/GridItem.js $d/components/ActionPanel/ActionPanel.js $d/components/OverlayControls/OverlayControls.js $d/index.js | head; grep -rln "react-grid-layout/css\|react-resizable/css" $d | head -3; echo "=== MenuItems / OverlayCustomControlItem ===" && sed -n 1,16p $d/typings/common.d.ts; sed -n 25,45p $d/components/OverlayControls/OverlayControls.d.ts; grep -rn "MenuItems" $d/constants/common.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -rn -A6 "export declare const MenuItems\|export const MenuItems" $d --include=*.d.ts | head -12; echo "=== drag/drop types ===" && grep -n -B1 -A12 "ItemDropProps\|ItemDragProps\|DraggedOverItem" $d/shared/types/common.d.ts | head -60; echo "=== eval run ===" && head -40 __agent_eval__/run.mjs

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo "--- inspect ---"; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Card Text Button Switch Icon Flex Label Progress Table Checkbox configure Lang useTheme 2>&1 | head -80; echo "--- icons ---"; for i in ChartColumn TrashBin Gear Plus Pencil Check LayoutHeaderCellsLarge Moon Sun TextAlignLeft Heading ListCheck Table ArrowUpRightFromSquare Grip ArrowsRotateLeft Xmark; do test -f node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/$i.js && echo "OK $i" || echo "MISSING $i"; done

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Card Text Button Switch Icon Flex Label Progress Table Checkbox configure Lang useTheme 2>&1 | head -60; u=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; echo "=== Card ==="; grep -n "view?\|type?\|theme?\|size?\|selected?\|disabled?" $u/Card/Card.d.ts | head -12; echo "=== Text variants ==="; grep -n "TEXT_VARIANTS\|'body-\|'caption-\|'header-\|'subheader-\|'display-" $u/Text/text/text.d.ts $u/Text/text/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "=== Progress ==="; grep -n "theme?\|value\|size?\|text?\|stack\|loading?" $u/Progress/Progress.d.ts $u/Progress/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "=== Label ==="; grep -n "theme?\|size?\|value?" $u/Label/Label.d.ts | head; echo "=== Switch ==="; grep -n "checked\|onUpdate\|size?\|content?" $u/Switch/Switch.d.ts $u/Controls/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== Table ==="; grep -n "columns\|data\|getRowId\|width?\|verticalAlign" $u/Table/Table.d.ts | head -14; grep -n "id:\|name\|template\|align\|width" $u/Table/Table.d.ts | sed -n 1,20p; echo "=== configure/Lang ==="; grep -rn "export declare function configure\|export declare enum Lang\|export declare const Lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts; echo "=== useTheme ==="; ls $u/theme/*.d.ts | head -20

u=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; echo "=== Card types ==="; grep -n "CardType\b.*=\|CardView\b.*=\|CardTheme\b.*=\|CardSize\b.*=" $u/components/Card/Card.d.ts; echo "=== Progress ==="; sed -n 1,30p $u/components/Progress/types.d.ts | grep -n "ProgressTheme\|ProgressSize\|size?\|text?"; echo "=== Switch/Checkbox props ==="; cat $u/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "checked?\|onUpdate?\|onChange?" $u/components/Controls/types.d.ts $u/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head; echo "=== configure ==="; grep -rln "export declare function configure" $u | head -2; grep -rn -A3 "export declare enum Lang\|export declare const Lang" $u/components/utils/configure.d.ts $u/utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== Text props ==="; sed -n 30,60p $u/components/Text/text/text.d.ts; echo "=== Button ==="; grep -n "view?\|size?\|pin?\|selected?\|loading?" $u/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head; echo "=== Flex ==="; grep -n "direction?\|gap?\|alignItems?\|justifyContent?\|wrap?\|grow?\|shrink?\|width?" $u/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -12; echo "=== Box ==="; grep -n "spacing?\|overflow?\|width?\|height?" $u/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts | head; echo "=== Label ==="; sed -n 20,45p $u/components/Label/Label.d.ts; echo "=== Divider ==="; ls $u/components/Divider/Divider.d.ts

grep -n -A14 "export interface ControlProps" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; grep -n "configure\|Lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -4; grep -n "useTheme\|useThemeValue" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts | head

cd /tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.319/8f9d2a827e8f2dcb93acf789745a7d2a/dataviz && grep -n -i -A12 "hero number\|stat tile" references/marks-and-anatomy.md | head -70; grep -n -i -B2 -A8 "stat tile" references/choosing-a-form.md | head -40

d=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; grep -rn "cols:\|rowHeight:\|margin:" $d/utils/register-manager.js $d/constants/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -8; grep -rln "cols:" $d --include=*.js | head -3; echo "=== delete handling ==="; grep -n -B2 -A8 "MenuItems.Delete\|removeItem" $d/components/OverlayControls/OverlayControls.js | head -50; echo "=== state types ==="; cat $d/shared/types/state-and-params.d.ts | head -40; echo "=== Text withMarkdown ==="; grep -n -A3 "get withMarkdown" $d/plugins/Text/Text.js

d=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; cat $d/components/index.d.ts $d/plugins/Title/index.d.ts $d/plugins/Text/index.d.ts; grep -n -B2 -A6 "registerPlugins\|already" $d/utils/register-manager.js | head -40; for i in ArrowUp ArrowDown SquareDashed ListUl Gauge; do test -f node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/$i.js && echo "OK $i" || echo "MISSING $i"; done; grep -n "height\|overflow" $d/components/GridItem/GridItem.css $d/components/Item/Item.css | head

sed -i "s/import {ActionPanel, DashKit, DashKitDnDWrapper, MenuItems} from '@gravity-ui\/dashkit';/import {ActionPanel, DashKit, DashKitDnDWrapper} from '@gravity-ui\/dashkit';/; s/overlayMenuItems={\[MenuItems.Delete\]}/overlayMenuItems={['delete']}/" src/dashboard/Dashboard.tsx && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20 && echo TSC_OK && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8

d=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; cat $d/plugins/Title/types.d.ts | head -20; echo "=== Item.css ==="; cat $d/components/Item/Item.css; echo "=== GridItem.css (item/content) ==="; grep -n -B1 -A6 "__item\b\|__item {" $d/components/GridItem/GridItem.css | head -40; echo "=== ActionPanel.css position ==="; grep -n "position\|bottom\|z-index" $d/components/ActionPanel/ActionPanel.css | head
cat .gitignore && rm -rf dist && git status --short
